name: pagis-desktop
description: The Pagis Client App installs and owns one exact local Server Runtime.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-design.mjs
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
